description: This file defines a client class for interacting with the Amazon Location Service Routes V2 via the AWS SDK for PHP. It specifies various methods related to geographic routing operations such as calculating isolines, route matrices, routes, optimizing waypoints, and snapping to roads.

classes.name: GeoRoutesClient
classes.description: A client class for interacting with Amazon Location Service Routes V2, extending the base AwsClient class and providing specific methods for geographic routing functionalities.

methods.name: calculateIsolines
methods.description: Calculates isolines based on input parameters.

methods.name: calculateIsolinesAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously calculates isolines based on input parameters.

methods.name: calculateRouteMatrix
methods.description: Calculates a matrix of routes between multiple origins and destinations.

methods.name: optimizeWaypoints
methods.description: Optimizes the order of waypoints for routing.
